description: Hand-written placeholder listing a few common queries. Replaced by the full catalogue.

queries.name: anim_time
queries.description: Seconds since the current animation started playing.

queries.name: life_time
queries.description: Seconds since the current animation or animation controller state started.

queries.name: delta_time
queries.description: Seconds between the previous frame and this one.

queries.name: is_baby
queries.description: 1 when the entity is a baby, otherwise 0.

queries.name: is_on_ground
queries.description: 1 when the entity is standing on the ground, otherwise 0.

queries.name: is_moving
queries.description: 1 when the entity is moving, otherwise 0.

queries.name: is_sneaking
queries.description: 1 when the entity is sneaking, otherwise 0.

queries.name: is_in_water
queries.description: 1 when the entity is in water, otherwise 0.

queries.name: is_alive
queries.description: 1 when the entity is alive, otherwise 0.

queries.name: health
queries.description: The entity's current health.

queries.name: max_health
queries.description: The entity's maximum health.

queries.name: modified_distance_moved
queries.description: Total horizontal distance the entity has moved, scaled for walk animations.

queries.name: ground_speed
queries.description: The entity's horizontal speed, in blocks per second.

queries.name: vertical_speed
queries.description: The entity's vertical speed, in blocks per second.

queries.name: variant
queries.description: The entity's variant index, as set by its minecraft:variant component.

queries.name: mark_variant
queries.description: The entity's mark variant index, as set by its minecraft:mark_variant component.

queries.name: time_of_day
queries.description: The time of day as a fraction of a full day, from 0 to 1.

queries.name: body_y_rotation
queries.description: The body's rotation around the vertical axis, in degrees.

queries.name: get_equipped_item_name
queries.description: The name of the item held in a hand, without its namespace.
notes: The hand is 0 or 'main_hand' for the main hand, 1 or 'off_hand' for the off hand.

queries.name: is_item_name_any
queries.description: 1 when the item in the given slot and index is any of the listed item names, otherwise 0.
notes: The slot index may be left out: q.is_item_name_any('slot.weapon.mainhand', 'minecraft:bow') is written that way in vanilla.

math.name: pi
math.description: The constant pi, as a float32. Not a function: write math.pi without parentheses.

math.name: abs
math.description: Absolute value.

math.name: acos
math.description: Arc cosine, in degrees.
notes: The argument is clamped to [-1, 1], so a value a rounding error outside the domain gives the endpoint rather than NaN.

math.name: asin
math.description: Arc sine, in degrees.
notes: The argument is clamped to [-1, 1], so a value a rounding error outside the domain gives the endpoint rather than NaN.

math.name: atan
math.description: Arc tangent, in degrees.

math.name: atan2
math.description: Arc tangent of y/x, in degrees, using both signs to pick the quadrant.

math.name: ceil
math.description: Rounds up to the next whole number.

math.name: clamp
math.description: Limits value to the range from min to max.
notes: The upper bound is tested first, so with min greater than max the result is max.

math.name: copy_sign
math.description: a with the sign of b.

math.name: cos
math.description: Cosine of an angle in degrees.

math.name: die_roll
math.description: Sum of num random numbers, each between low and high.
notes: Draws num random numbers; the result differs every evaluation.

math.name: die_roll_integer
math.description: Sum of num random whole numbers, each from low to high inclusive.
notes: Draws num random numbers; the result differs every evaluation.

math.name: exp
math.description: e raised to the power of value.

math.name: floor
math.description: Rounds down to the previous whole number.

math.name: hermite_blend
math.description: The smoothstep curve 3t^2 - 2t^3 at value.

math.name: inverse_lerp
math.description: Where value lies between start and end, as a fraction: 0 at start, 1 at end.
notes: Unlike the / operator, a zero span (start equal to end) is not guarded and gives an infinity or NaN.

math.name: lerp
math.description: Linear interpolation from start to end by t.

math.name: lerprotate
math.description: Interpolates between two angles in degrees along the shorter way round.

math.name: ln
math.description: Natural logarithm.

math.name: max
math.description: The larger of a and b.

math.name: min
math.description: The smaller of a and b.

math.name: min_angle
math.description: The same angle wrapped into the range -180 to 180.

math.name: mod
math.description: Remainder of value divided by denominator.

math.name: pow
math.description: base raised to the power of exponent.

math.name: random
math.description: A random number between low and high.
notes: Draws one random number; the result differs every evaluation.

math.name: random_integer
math.description: A random whole number from low to high inclusive.
notes: Draws one random number; the result differs every evaluation.

math.name: round
math.description: Rounds to the nearest whole number.

math.name: sign
math.description: 1 for a positive value and -1 for a negative one.

math.name: sin
math.description: Sine of an angle in degrees.

math.name: sqrt
math.description: Square root.

math.name: trunc
math.description: Drops the fractional part, rounding towards zero.

math.name: ease_in_quad
math.description: Interpolates from start to end by t along a quad curve that eases in (slow start).
notes: t is not clamped: values outside 0 to 1 extrapolate the curve.

math.name: ease_out_quad
math.description: Interpolates from start to end by t along a quad curve that eases out (slow finish).
notes: t is not clamped: values outside 0 to 1 extrapolate the curve.

math.name: ease_in_out_quad
math.description: Interpolates from start to end by t along a quad curve that eases in and out.

namespaces.name: query
namespaces.description: Read-only values and functions the game provides about the entity, block or world being evaluated.

namespaces.name: math
namespaces.description: Mathematical functions and the constant math.pi.

namespaces.name: variable
namespaces.description: Variables belonging to the entity, kept between evaluations. Readable and writable.

namespaces.name: temp
namespaces.description: Scratch values for the current evaluation. Readable and writable.

namespaces.name: context
namespaces.description: Values the game supplies for the place the expression runs in. Read-only.

namespaces.name: array
namespaces.description: Arrays defined by the host, indexed with array.name[index].
